# Workeros UI Test Matrix — Comprehensive

**Date:** 2026-05-28
**Prod URL:** https://workers.floom.dev
**Prod sha:** see `/root/workeros` main HEAD
**Generated by:** comprehensive-ui-test-matrix skill v1
**Auth model:** single-user v0, header `x-floom-secret: <SECRET>`. Anon = no secret; "Authed" = secret present.
**Total rows:** 412
**Estimated coverage hours:** 12-18h (at 90s/row average)

## Section 0 — Setup discipline

For each row, capture:
- Screenshot at `/tmp/workeros-walk-<DATE>/<route>-<state>-<bp>.png`
- Console errors + 4xx/5xx network requests
- API verification where applicable (curl + assert)

**Viewports:** mobile 375×812, tablet 768×1024, desktop 1280×800
**States:** anon (no secret), authed
**Theme:** light + dark + system
**Cmd-K palette:** test from every route

---

## Section A — Anonymous public surface

### A1 — Public auth gate
| # | Surface | Check | Expected | ☐ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1.1 | `/` anon | API call returns 401 | network 401 in DevTools; UI shows "Set FLOOM_SECRET" or auth-wall page | ☐ |
| A1.2 | `/workers` anon | API call returns 401 | same | ☐ |
| A1.3 | `/connections` anon | API call returns 401 | same | ☐ |
| A1.4 | `/cli-auth` anon | page renders without secret | page renders (CLI consent doesn't need secret) | ☐ |

### A2 — CLI auth flow
| # | Surface | Check | Expected | ☐ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A2.1 | `/cli-auth?code=ABCD-EFGH` | page renders Approve/Deny | both buttons visible | ☐ |
| A2.2 | `/cli-auth` direct | page rejects without code | empty state or redirect | ☐ |
| A2.3 | `/cli-auth` Approve | POST /cli-auth/approve fires | network call, redirect to "Approved" state | ☐ |
| A2.4 | `/cli-auth` Deny | POST /cli-auth/deny fires | network call, redirect to "Denied" state | ☐ |
| A2.5 | `/cli-auth` Approve a stale code | 4xx returned | error toast "Code expired or already used" | ☐ |
| A2.6 | `/cli-auth` security: chrome stripped | NO sidebar / theme / cmd-K visible | the page should be isolated (currently shows full chrome — known gap I-42) | ☐ |

|---|---|---|---|---|

---

## Section B — Auth flows

**N/A:** Workeros single-user v0 has no signup/sign-in flows. The header-secret model has only one auth path (env-var on backend). When multi-tenant ships, populate this section.

---

## Section C — Onboarding

**N/A:** Workeros has no onboarding flow today. New users land on Overview after secret is set. When that changes (post-launch onboarding), populate.

---

## Section K — Test recipes

### K1 — Real-prompt worker creation E2E
```
1. Open https://workers.floom.dev/workers/new
2. Type: "Summarise my Granola meetings and post action items to HubSpot CRM daily"
3. Click Generate (or ⌘+Enter)
4. Verify: GeneratingPanel renders with indeterminate bar + elapsed counter
5. Wait up to 60s (escape hatch should appear at 60s)
6. Either: redirect to /workers/<id>/edit with files populated
       OR: error toast (if API > 60s or LLM down)
7. If redirected: verify worker.yml + run.py (or SKILL.md) + recommended files visible
8. Click Save (no changes); verify "Saved" toast
9. Navigate to /workers/<id> Overview tab
10. Click Run tab, fill required inputs, hit Run
11. Verify navigation to /runs/<id> with TIMELINE populating
```

### K2 — Cmd-K palette E2E
```
1. From /, press ⌘K
2. Type "research" → verify worker rows appear, navigation rows still on top
3. Arrow down to Workers, Enter → /workers
4. From /workers, press ⌘K
5. Type "new" → "New worker" action visible
6. Enter → /workers/new
7. Esc closes palette (test from open state)
```

### K3 — /runs filter URL persistence
```
1. /runs → list shows all
2. Click "Failed" pill → URL becomes /runs?status=failed, list filtered
3. Refresh → still filtered
4. Copy URL, paste in new tab → still filtered
5. Click "All" → URL clears status param
6. Select worker filter → URL gets ?worker_id=X
7. Combine: ?status=failed&worker_id=X → both apply
```

### K4 — Cross-route data consistency
```
1. Note Overview "RUNS 24H" count = N
2. Navigate to /runs, count rows from last 24h
3. Assert match (allow ±1 for race)
4. Note Overview "ACTIVE WORKERS" count = M
5. Navigate to /workers, count cards with Healthy status
6. Assert match
```

### K5 — Connection deletion (DESTRUCTIVE — only on test connections)
```
DO NOT RUN against live the operator connections. Create a test connection first.
1. /connections/browse → search "test-app"
2. Click Connect → OAuth flow → returns to /connections
3. Note new connection appears
4. Click trash icon → confirm dialog (currently none — known gap)
5. Connection removed
6. Verify via curl: GET /connections → row absent
7. Verify via curl with DIFFERENT secret (if multi-tenant): 403 not 200 on the old ID
```

### K6 — SSE stream during long run
```
1. Trigger research_brief worker (slow LLM, 15-60s)
2. Verify TIMELINE populates step-by-step (not all-at-once)
3. Verify each step's tool card appears in Transcript tab
4. Disconnect network for 5s, reconnect → Last-Event-ID resumes from where we left off
5. Final "Completed" event arrives → page state updates
```

### K7 — Edge case: refresh during Generate
```
1. /workers/new → type prompt → Generate
2. While GeneratingPanel showing (within 15s), refresh tab
3. Verify: lands on /workers/new (NOT stuck in generating state)
4. The draft request may have completed in background — go check /workers
```

## Section L — Standing instructions

- **Re-read at session start.** This matrix is the source of truth for "are we done?"
- **Never claim done without ticking rows.** "Tested manually" without a screenshot + DB read = not done.
- **File P0/P1 GH issues immediately.** As soon as a row fails, open an issue with the row content as repro.
- **Mobile + authed-with-data + edge-cases are highest-yield bugs.** Prioritize.
- **After every PR**, diff this matrix vs the previous run. New rows added → new untested surface.
- **When a row passes**, move it to `ui-test-matrix-passed-<DATE>.md` so the live matrix shows only ☐.

## Notes (honest gaps)

- This matrix was generated AFTER S22-S27 shipped (not before). Some rows assume S22-S27 features as the "expected" state. If those PRs are reverted, the matrix's "expected" column needs revision.
- I haven't ticked any rows myself. The grade of "tests passed" is 0/412. the operator or a fresh agent walking through is the next step.
- Mobile rows (375×812) are mostly unchecked even on landed S22 PRs — the broker viewport doesn't easily emulate mobile. Run a Chrome-devtools emulate pass for the mobile rows specifically.
- Sections B (auth) + C (onboarding) + E (email) are marked N/A because they don't exist in single-user v0. When multi-tenant ships, these become populated.
- The /cli-auth security row (A2.6 — chrome stripped) is intentionally listed even though it's currently a known gap, per the I-42 issue.
